snippet.title: Woodworm - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Woodworm is a grid-based puzzle game about carving bite-sized wooden sculptures. Chomp your way through blocks of wood to create new shapes, while managing gravity and tricky geometry!

This game is an expansion and re-imagining of the original PICO-8 hit WOODWORM - with updated visuals, sound, and even more puzzles. I've been working on it for a while and I'm excited to see people play it!

If you are interested you can buy the game on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3404590/Woodworm/
